$comment: Provenance for third-party bundles vendored into src/VersoBlueprint/vendor/ and redistributed in every generated site (CX-028). `sha256`/`bytes` are the authoritative byte identity, recomputed by tests/harness/test_vendor_provenance.py; a byte change with no manifest update fails that test. `verified` distinguishes facts read from the bundle itself (its banner) from facts declared from upstream but not independently reproduced from the vendored bytes. The rendered notices are carried by d3LicenseInfo / d3GraphvizLicenseInfo in src/VersoBlueprint/PreviewManifest.lean and surfaced on the site via the {licenseInfo} block (CX-041).

verified.note: The bundle's first line reads `// https://d3js.org v7.9.0 Copyright 2010-2023 Mike Bostock`. The d3 v7.9.0 upstream tag is ISC-licensed.

The bundle carries no version/copyright banner. The IDE preview widget (src/VersoBlueprint/Widget.lean) references CDN d3-graphviz 5.6.0, but that coordinate is not independently reproduced from the vendored bytes. The SHA-256 above is the ground-truth byte identity; d3-graphviz has been BSD-3-Clause across the 5.x line.
